title: HDM Activity Primitive Contracts — Physical Manifest
$comment: Physical-representation shape of DEV/CATALOG/activity-primitive-contracts/manifest.json. Global contract-level state not owned by a single primitive. Reuses top-level property definitions from the canonical logical schema (activity-primitive-contracts.schema.json) via $ref rather than duplicating them; per-primitive state lives in the paired primitive shards and shared vocabulary files, reassembled by DEV/TOOLS/activity_primitive_contracts.py into the logical contract validated by activity-primitive-contracts.schema.json.
